name: sdkprf
description: Syntax highlighting and language support for .sdkprf (Sodukuvania proof) files.

sdkprf.unicodeInput.enabled.markdownDescription: Type a LaTeX name such as `\to` or `\forall`, then press Space or Tab to replace it with the Unicode symbol. Typing a backslash also opens the symbol completion list.

sdkprf.rainbowBrackets.enabled.markdownDescription: Draw `[]`, `()`, and `{}` in six colors by nesting depth. When disabled, the 6-color decorations are removed; enable `editor.bracketPairColorization.enabled` manually to use VS Code's native bracket colors.

enumDescriptions: Use a high-contrast six-color palette chosen for the current light or dark theme (recommended; avoids dark brackets in dark themes).
Use the current theme's editorBracketHighlight.foreground1..6 colors.
sdkprf.rainbowBrackets.palette.markdownDescription: Color palette for rainbow brackets. The default `accessible` palette picks high-contrast colors for the current light or dark theme; `theme` follows the theme's bracket highlight colors.

scripts.test: node test/parser.test.js && node test/scan.test.js && node test/brackets.test.js && node test/latex.test.js && node test/tokenize.test.js && node test/extension.test.js
